assessments.assessment: The conditional cache branch distinguishes reads invoked after the relevant acknowledgement from permitted overlapping snapshots and identifies acknowledgement/consistency scope. Returned source values, publication, replica freshness and floor lifetime have separate evidence requirements. A rejected stale fill does not implicitly establish a fresh direct response; modeled or successful-call evidence is not promoted to restart, crash or production guarantees.

The cutover pointer reaches a state record for serving authority, worker disposition, traffic, recovery ownership and bounded decisions. It separates confirmed failure from unknown timeout outcomes using actual engine semantics. The consolidated eligible-writer matrix preserves atomic revision maintenance, evidence and admission boundaries for old, bridge, current, maintenance and replay writers; unknown maintenance still blocks equality-based reads. Locking rehearsals and complete value/revision comparisons remain proposed unless executed, without transferring a product-specific migration API to every engine.

The direct timeout/cancellation pointer reaches distinct caller, owned-work and reuse bounds. Cancellation signalling is separated from joining and resource reuse; possible wait_for overrun, pending wait tasks and actual awaitable/runtime semantics are explicit. Cleanup remains owned/accounted until completion or safe disposal; unavailable stop guarantees leave recovery time unproven with containment/backpressure. The source ledger separates checking documentation from behavioral/runtime evidence.

The review-only branch requires a complete visible revision-labelled recommendation, identical full text/evidence delivered for independent review, visible returned draft identity/findings, and re-review of material corrections. It adds observable conclusion review while respecting no-file-change tasks and avoiding an unrelated role roster. An incapable host leaves evidence unresolved. The shared handoff remains the general ownership/review source; this branch supplies its workflow-specific no-file mechanics.

Concise entrypoint pointers retain detailed rules in their references.
